description_quote: No scheduling of work orders at a Draft status can take place
Once a work order is Released, you can execute a work order
Scheduling can take place for these work orders
transitions: Unreleased → Released / On-Hold / Cancel; ย้อนเป็น Draft ไม่ได้

description_quote: A Complete status for an eAM work order does not require any operation to be completed
You cannot charge any accounts once an eAM work order is closed
eAM work orders at Released and Unreleased statuses can be put on hold
transitions: พักงานจาก Released/Unreleased

description_quote: You can cancel an eAM work order at any status in its lifecycle
